landing.heroSubtitle: CiviLedger bridges institutional authorities, citizens, and verifiers with a decentralized trust ledger. Issue tamper-proof certificates, maintain sovereign citizen custody, and verify authentications in milliseconds.
landing.featuresHeading: Built for National Scale & Enterprise Trust
landing.feat1Desc: Credentials are cryptographically hashed and anchored on an immutable blockchain ledger. Any tampering or unauthorized alteration is instantaneously invalidated.
landing.feat2Desc: Citizens hold sovereign custody of their credentials in self-sovereign wallets, sharing only the exact verified claims required without revealing sensitive underlying data.
landing.feat3Desc: Verifiers authenticate student transcripts, national IDs, and business licenses in milliseconds via QR or cryptographic share tokens with zero phone calls or manual paperwork.
landing.step1Desc: Authorized institutions join via consortium governance and deploy cryptographic signing keys anchored to the public ledger.
landing.step2Desc: Institutional authorities sign and issue standardized credentials directly to citizens' decentralized identifiers (DIDs).
landing.step3Desc: Citizens securely hold, manage, and audit their credentials using decentralized Web3 wallets with granular consent controls.
landing.step4Desc: Verifiers scan QR presentations or inspect cryptographic share tokens directly against on-chain smart contract registries.
landing.role1Subtitle: Universities, licensing boards, and ministries issuing tamper-proof credentials at scale.
landing.role2Subtitle: Store verified digital credentials in a personal Web3 vault and present them anywhere.
landing.role3Subtitle: Instant cryptographic audit and verification node for HR, banks, and regulatory bodies.
landing.archNode1Desc: High-performance enterprise UI with role-based routing and internationalization.
landing.archNode2Desc: EIP-712 credential hashing, signature verification, and secure presentation token generation.
landing.archNode3Desc: Compliant off-chain encrypted credential storage and consent audit logging.
landing.archNode4Desc: CredentialRegistry, IssuerRegistry, and Multi-Sig Governance on-chain anchors.
landing.footerDesc: Empowering national public sector trust with decentralized verifiable credentials.
